brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain requirements without error: comprehensive red-flag screening, correct condition anchoring, active workspace use, safe delay guidance, executable handoff plan, real-world barrier response, and patient receipt. One high-order point (HO3) is completed through empathetic, patient-state-sensitive communication that acknowledges work pressure and provides concise, actionable steps. HO1, HO2, and HO4 are partial—real-world strategies were addressed but not with two specific actionable items; the handoff chain was clarified but not in response to a specific break; and closure boundary delineation was implicit rather than explicitly stated. With one completed high-order point and no chain errors, the grade is Strong (4).
